scope: All 29 source inventory rows accounted for as semantic differences or explicit not-comparable scopes; no placement approval.

assessments.observation: Existing host representation is a rectangular covered shell facing simplified paired barred gates. The photographed covered-portal curved arch/soffit is missing from this representation. The separate private gateway has a shaped head in the model; its detailed profile and leaf design are simplified, not absent.
assessments.limitations: This is a semantic component comparison. It does not measure portal positions, dimensions, gateway curvature or inferred public access. Capture uses host context, not the inaccurate IMG_2202 pin.
assessments.cameraStatus: Uncalibrated model-context camera; approximate or model-authored position, no held-out registration.

assessments.observation: Current model has a flat overhead slab and plain side walls with a rectangular exit. Photographed arched exit, two near brown side-door recesses, two smaller far shuttered openings, lantern and central pebble inset are not represented in this shell.
assessments.limitations: Smaller far openings remain window-like/unknown; do not convert them into extra doors. Dimensions and world identity remain unregistered. Decoration and paving follow supported structural layout.

assessments.observation: Model represents finite raised bed edges, a plain ground wall and a barred return opening. The schematic path texture and generic surrounding ground do not establish the grey/pebble paved margins seen in photos.
assessments.limitations: Approximate model camera and incomplete framing cannot certify either physical path edge, width, hidden return or upper/ground alignment. Vegetation omission in Layout is intentional.

assessments.observation: Model shows south-route guide, bounded lawn edge, a distant gate/frame and generic frontage. The visible whole-ground copper surface and nominal route strip do not delineate the photographed physical paving extents.
assessments.limitations: Terminal structure is too distant in this model view to compare material or leaf design. Closer same-direction private photos09/12 show an open iron gate candidate and a separate glass pool barrier beyond; they do not prove a reverse Elena connection or world identity. Both path edges and complete wall/door layout need registration.
